AUTHENTIC AYURVEDIC CARE

Our Panchakarma Therapies

Traditional Ayurvedic therapies administered by trained Panchakarma specialists under Dr. Umesh Shukla’s supervision.

01

Vamana

Therapeutic Emesis

A traditional Panchkarma therapy involving carefully supervised therapeutic emesis as part of a personalized Ayurvedic treatment plan.

Indications / Conditions
Kapha-related congestion, recurrent respiratory concerns, and selected skin conditions after assessment.
Duration
Prepared in stages over several days; the main procedure is scheduled by the physician.
Protocol
Individual assessment, preparation, supervised procedure, rest, and a graduated post-therapy diet.

Key benefits

  • Dosha-focused cleansing
  • Respiratory support
  • Guided recovery

02

Virechana

Therapeutic Ayurvedic Cleansing

A traditional Panchkarma therapy involving controlled therapeutic purgation to support the elimination of accumulated doshas.

Indications / Conditions
Pitta-related digestive, skin, and metabolic concerns selected through consultation.
Duration
Preparation and recovery are planned around the individual; the active protocol is physician-directed.
Protocol
Assessment, preparatory care, supervised cleansing, hydration, rest, and a structured return to food.

Key benefits

  • Digestive balance
  • Skin support
  • Personalized cleansing

03

Basti

Medicated Ayurvedic Therapy

A classical Panchkarma therapy using a physician-selected medicated oil or decoction protocol to support balance and comfort.

Indications / Conditions
Lower-back and joint discomfort, digestive irregularity, and Vata-related concerns.
Duration
Delivered as a planned course; each session length depends on the selected protocol.
Protocol
Clinical assessment, preparation, selected Basti sequence, observation, and follow-up guidance.

Key benefits

  • Vata balance
  • Joint comfort
  • Digestive support

Nasya

Nasal Ayurvedic Therapy

A traditional Ayurvedic therapy in which carefully selected medicated oils or preparations are administered through the nasal passages.

Head, neck, sinus, migraine, and upper respiratory concerns following assessment.
Duration
A focused session with preparation and aftercare tailored to the selected medicine.
Protocol
Face and sinus preparation, physician-selected nasal application, rest, and simple aftercare.

Key benefits

  • Head and sinus support

Raktamokshana

Leech Therapy

A classical bloodletting therapy, including carefully selected leech therapy, performed only when clinically appropriate and under specialist supervision.

Indications / Conditions
Localized skin and circulation-related concerns where the physician considers it appropriate.
Duration
Short, carefully monitored sessions with review and aftercare as advised.
Protocol
Screening and consent, sterile preparation, supervised application, wound care, and review.

Key benefits

  • Localized support
  • Skin care

Ayurvedic Oil Massage

A traditional full-body Ayurvedic massage using warm herbal oils selected according to individual needs and Ayurvedic assessment.

Indications / Conditions

Duration
Session duration and course frequency are selected according to the treatment plan.
Protocol

07

Shirodhara

Ayurvedic Oil Flow Therapy

A classical Ayurvedic therapy in which a gentle, continuous stream of warm medicated oil or selected liquids is poured over the forehead.

Indications / Conditions
Stress, sleep concerns, mental fatigue, and tension-related discomfort after consultation.
Duration
A calm, focused session with duration set according to the selected protocol.
Protocol
Comfortable positioning, warm oil flow, quiet rest, gentle cleansing, and follow-up advice.

Key benefits

  • Calming routine
  • Restful sleep support
  • Mental relaxation
